meta.name: triage
meta.description: Move issues and external PRs through a state machine of triage roles — categorise, verify, grill if needed, and write agent-ready briefs.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把问题和外部提交有序分流，生成现成的任务简报
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你维护活跃的仓库，每天要处理大量问题和外部贡献的改动。
copy.tagline_en: Triage issues and external PRs in order, producing ready-to-use task briefs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain an active repository and deal with many issues and external contributions regularly.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把 GitHub 问题或外部 PR 分类成 bug 或改进，并标上待处理、等补充、可交给 agent 等状态；它还会验证描述、提问澄清、写出给 agent 的待办简报，所有评论都注明由 AI 生成。
howto.when: 当你在聊天里输入“/triage”并自然说出想做的事，比如“看看哪些问题需要我处理”或“处理 #42”时触发。

say.text: /triage 看看哪些问题需要我处理
say.note: 会列出未分类和待分诊的问题。
会直接应用状态，并确认是否写 agent 简报。

say.text: 检查 #12 是 bug 还是 enhancement
say.note: 会收集上下文并给出分类建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude triages GitHub issues or external PRs into categories (bug or enhancement) and states (needs-triage, needs-info, ready-for-agent, etc.). It verifies claims, asks clarifying questions, and may write agent-ready briefs. All triage comments note they are AI-generated.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you type "/triage" and describe what you want, e.g., listing issues that need attention or handling a specific issue number.

say_en.note: Applies the state and asks about an agent brief.

say_en.text: Check if #12 is a bug or enhancement
say_en.note: Gathers context and recommends a category.
